counterfactual_missing_items: Oxford Scale muscle strength was 5 of 5 throughout
decisive_items: symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal joints (MCPs) and interphalangeal joints (IPs)
response.rationale: R4 is the best composite: multiple specific cutaneous and articular spans (ulcerated lichenoid papules, symmetric MCP/IP swelling, tender ulcerations) plus ILD and interface/vasculopathic biopsy; normal strength and low CK fit amyopathic DM. R5 has only lymphocytopenia as raw support and lacks the characteristic palmar/MCP skin lesions; its negative serologies do not establish SLE.

rejected.why: Redundant completion of R4; only restates tender ulcerations without independent raw support.
Narrow temporal restatement of ILD; not a systemic diagnosis.
ILD is a complication/manifestation, not the underlying diagnosis; ignores skin/joint/lab evidence.
aCL alone is insufficient; negative lupus anticoagulant/beta2GP1 and no thrombotic criteria.
Anti-SSA alone without sicca; no raw support for Sjogren.
Single-antibody completion; lacks clinical APS features.
No raw support; anti-SSA is nonspecific.
Redundant completion of R5; only restates lymphocytopenia.
